source_document: Case File No. 24/2024 (Police Station Batathu, District Kangra, HP)

documents.title: First Information Report No. 24/2024
documents.document_role: Primary crime registration and initial investigation assignment
documents.extracted_summary: Initial registration under Sections 15 and 25 NDPS Act; secret information recording, Batathu naka establishment, Canter HP72D-3928 interception, recovery of 4 bags of suspected poppy husk (108.9 kg), sampling, sealing, personal search (nil recovery), and assignment of investigation to ASI Nirmal Patial.

documents.title: Seizure / Recovery Memo (Fard Makboozgi)
documents.document_role: Spot recovery and contraband weighment documentation
documents.extracted_summary: Spot seizure documentation of 4 bags containing suspected poppy husk, weighed separately (Bag 1: 27.2 kg, Bag 2: 26.8 kg, Bag 3: 27.5 kg, Bag 4: 27.4 kg; Total: 108 kg 900 g). Representative sample lots drawn, sealed with seal impression 'PS-BATATHU-1', sample seal impression taken on NCB form in triplicate.

facts.place: Batathu Naka near Gandhi Suvidha Kendra

documents.title: Personal Search Memo (Jama Talashi Fard)
documents.extracted_summary: Physical search of accused Manoj Kumar and Rajesh Kumar conducted at the spot. Personal articles recovered: cash Rs. 2,450/-, mobile phones, driving license, and RC of HP72D-3928. Zero contraband or narcotic substance recovered from physical person.

persons_searched: Manoj Kumar s/o Sh. Ramesh Kumar
Rajesh Kumar s/o Sh. Balwant Singh
facts.result: Nil narcotic contraband found on physical person

documents.title: Arrest Memo & Inspection Memo
documents.document_role: Accused custody and statutory arrest notification
documents.extracted_summary: Formal arrest memo of Manoj Kumar (driver) and Rajesh Kumar (passenger/occupant). Grounds of arrest under Sections 15 & 25 NDPS Act explained in Hindi. Intimation of arrest communicated to brother Suresh Kumar via telephone at 12:15 hrs.

documents.document_name: State Forensic Science Laboratory Chemical Report
documents.title: State Forensic Science Laboratory (SFSL) Chemical Examination Report
documents.extracted_summary: SFSL Examination Report No. FSL-NDPS-842/2024. Parcels received sealed with seal 'PS-BATATHU-1' intact and matching specimen seal. Microscopic examination identified plant material of Papaver somniferum L. (Poppy Straw). Chemical and TLC analysis gave positive tests for Morphine, Codeine, and Thebaine.

facts.parcel_condition: Cloth parcel received with 4 intact seals matching specimen seal 'PS-BATATHU-1'
facts.test_results: Positive for Papaver somniferum L. (Poppy straw / Bhukki) containing natural opium alkaloids including Morphine

documents.title: Certificate of Magistrate under Section 52A NDPS Act
documents.document_role: Judicial certification of seized inventory and supervised sample drawing
documents.extracted_summary: Judicial certificate issued under Section 52A(2) by Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMIC). Verifies 4 parcels (P-1 to P-4). Electronic scale weights: P-1: 27.260 kg, P-2: 26.800 kg, P-3: 27.480 kg, P-4: 27.400 kg (Total: 108.940 kg). Supervised drawing of 2 duplicate samples of 250g each from each parcel and affixing of Court Seal 'JMIC-1'.

facts.magistrate_court: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class, Kangra / Nurpur

documents.title: Inventory of Seized Narcotic Drugs & Substances u/s 52A
documents.document_role: Police inventory and application submitted to Magistrate
documents.extracted_summary: Detailed inventory schedule prepared by IO and submitted to the Magistrate under Section 52A(2). Itemizes 4 seized gunny bags (P-1 to P-4) with recorded weights: P-1: 27.200 kg, P-2: 26.800 kg, P-3: 27.500 kg, P-4: 27.400 kg (Total: 108 kg 900 g). Notes seals 'PS-BATATHU-1' and 'SHO-BATATHU'.

documents.title: Resealing Certificate under Section 55 NDPS Act
documents.document_role: Police station custody resealing by Station House Officer
documents.extracted_summary: Certificate executed by SHO PS Batathu under Section 55 NDPS Act. Confirms 4 parcels produced by ASI Nirmal Patial bearing IO seal 'PS-BATATHU-1'. Resealed with SHO station seal 'SHO-BATATHU' and handed over to MHC for Malkhana safe custody.

documents.title: Resealing Certificate u/s 55 NDPS Act (Duplicate Copy)
documents.document_role: Duplicate copy of Section 55 Resealing Certificate
documents.extracted_summary: Duplicate carbon copy of Document 686. Retained as distinct source file artifact while duplicate detection engine prevents double-counting evidentiary facts.

documents.title: Special Report under Section 57 NDPS Act
documents.document_role: Statutory report of arrest and seizure to immediate official superior within 48 hours
documents.extracted_summary: Comprehensive statutory report submitted by ASI Nirmal Patial to Dy. SP Jawali. Details information received, naka setup, Canter HP72D-3928 interception, recovery of 4 bags (108.9 kg), sampling, sealing, personal search, arrest, FIR registration, and property handling. Receipt acknowledged on 09/04/2024.

facts.submitted_to: Deputy Superintendent of Police, Sub-Division Jawali

documents.title: Case Diary (Zimni) No. 1 — Interception & Search
documents.document_role: Contemporaneous investigation log under Section 172 CrPC
documents.extracted_summary: Case Diary Zimni No. 1. Records departure to Batathu naka at 09:45 hrs, interception of Canter HP72D-3928 at 10:15 hrs, particulars of driver Manoj Kumar and occupant Rajesh Kumar, search of cabin, and discovery of 4 gunny bags.

documents.title: Case Diary (Zimni) No. 2 — Weighment, Sampling & Rukka
documents.document_role: Contemporaneous investigation log of spot recovery proceedings
documents.extracted_summary: Case Diary Zimni No. 2. Records weighing of 4 bags (27.2kg, 26.8kg, 27.5kg, 27.4kg), drawing of representative samples S-1 and S-2, sealing with PS-BATATHU-1, and dispatch of Rukka to PS Batathu at 11:15 hrs via C. Amit Kumar.

documents.title: Case Diary (Zimni) No. 3 — Personal Search & Arrest
documents.document_role: Contemporaneous investigation log of search, arrest and site plan
documents.extracted_summary: Case Diary Zimni No. 3. Records execution of Personal Search Memos (nil contraband), formal arrest of Manoj Kumar (11:45) and Rajesh Kumar (11:50), telephone intimation to brother Suresh Kumar, and preparation of Nazri Naksha (spot site plan).

documents.title: Case Diary (Zimni) No. 4 — Station Return, Resealing & Malkhana
documents.document_role: Contemporaneous investigation log of PS arrival and safe custody
documents.extracted_summary: Case Diary Zimni No. 4. Records return of police party to PS Batathu at 13:10 hrs. Production of 4 parcels before SHO for Section 55 resealing with seal SHO-BATATHU. Deposit of case property into Malkhana under Register No. 19.

documents.title: Case Diary (Zimni) No. 5 — Section 57 Report & S. 52A Application
documents.document_role: Contemporaneous investigation log of statutory reports and court moves
documents.extracted_summary: Case Diary Zimni No. 5. Records dispatch of Section 57 report to Dy. SP Jawali. Drafting and submission of formal application under Section 52A NDPS Act before Court of JMIC Kangra for inventory certification and sample drawal.

documents.title: Malkhana Property Movement Register Extract & Investigation Report
documents.document_role: Malkhana property movement and safe custody log
documents.extracted_summary: Malkhana Register (Mud No. 19/2024) extract. Documents deposit of 4 parcels on 08/04/2024, temporary withdrawal for Section 52A court proceedings on 10/04/2024, redeposit, and dispatch of sealed samples to SFSL Dharamshala via Road Certificate (RC) No. 42/2024.

procedural_steps.description: The FIR describes information being received regarding transportation of poppy husk.
The FIR describes the information being entered/recorded in the General Diary with date and time details.
The FIR narrative describes prior information being prepared and sent to the Dy. SP through the stated official channel.
The FIR describes formation and presence of a police party for the interception and search operation.
The FIR describes establishment of a naka / checking point near the Gandhi Suvidha Kendra at Batathu.
The FIR describes interception / stopping of a suspected canter bearing registration number HP72D-3928.
The FIR records identification / particulars of persons present in the vehicle (Manoj Kumar and Rajesh Kumar).
The FIR describes search of the vehicle.
The FIR describes recovery of four bags containing suspected poppy husk from inside the vehicle.
The FIR and Seizure Memo record separate weighing of the four bags with a total quantity of 108 kg 900 g.
The FIR and Seizure Memo describe taking the recovered material into police possession and documenting seizure proceedings.
The FIR and Seizure Memo describe drawing representative samples from the seized material.
The FIR and Seizure Memo describe sealing and marking of seized bags and samples with seal impression 'PS-BATATHU-1'.
The FIR and Seizure Memo mention NCB-Triplicate documentation prepared in connection with the seized material.
The FIR and Personal Search Memo describe personal/physical searches of the concerned persons.
The FIR and Personal Search Memo record that no narcotic substance was found during personal search.
The FIR refers to checking and recovery of vehicle-related documents, including RC and DL.
The FIR describes taking the vehicle HP72D-3928 and relevant articles into police possession.
The FIR and Seizure Memo record preparation of written seizure and recovery documentation at the spot.
The FIR and Seizure Memo describe signatures being obtained from relevant police witnesses and accused.
The case is recorded as registered under Section 15 and Section 25 NDPS Act at PS Batathu.
The FIR identifies ASI Nirmal Patial as the investigating officer directed to take up the investigation.
The FIR form records that the FIR was read over to the informant/complainant and admitted to be correctly recorded.
The FIR form records that a copy was supplied to the complainant/informant free of cost.
The Arrest Memo records formal arrest of driver Manoj Kumar and occupant Rajesh Kumar with grounds explained in Hindi and intimation to family.
SFSL Report No. FSL-NDPS-842/2024 documents laboratory analysis confirming samples as Papaver somniferum L. (Poppy straw / Bhukki) containing Morphine alkaloids.

source_locations.contents: Header, Sections 15 & 25, GD entry, Section 42(2) forwarding to Dy. SP, and Batathu naka setup.
Interception of Canter HP72D-3928, vehicle search, recovery of 4 bags of poppy husk (108.9 kg), sampling, sealing, and personal search.
FIR conclusion, signatures, free copy supply, and investigation handover to ASI Nirmal Patial.
Detailed weighment of 4 bags (27.2kg, 26.8kg, 27.5kg, 27.4kg), seal impressions 'PS-BATATHU-1', NCB triplicate forms.
Physical search of Manoj Kumar & Rajesh Kumar, recovery of cash Rs. 2,450, DL/RC, nil contraband on person.
Arrest of Manoj Kumar (11:45 hrs) and Rajesh Kumar (11:50 hrs), grounds communicated, brother Suresh Kumar informed.
SFSL Report FSL-NDPS-842/2024, intact seal 'PS-BATATHU-1', chemical and microscopic tests positive for Poppy Straw (Morphine).
Section 52A Magistrate Certificate, verified parcels P-1 to P-4, court electronic weighment (108.940 kg total), supervised sampling.
Section 52A Police Inventory of 4 gunny bags (P-1 to P-4) with total weight 108 kg 900 g and prayer for disposal certification.
Section 55 Resealing Certificate by SHO PS Batathu, resealing with SHO-BATATHU over original IO seal PS-BATATHU-1.
Exact duplicate copy of Section 55 Resealing Certificate Document 686.
Statutory Special Report under Section 57 submitted to Dy. SP Jawali on 09/04/2024 within 24 hours of seizure and arrest.
Case Diary Zimni 1: departure to naka, secret information recording, interception of Canter HP72D-3928 at 10:15 hrs.
Case Diary Zimni 2: spot weighment of 4 bags, representative sampling, sealing, and Rukka dispatch at 11:15 hrs.
Case Diary Zimni 3: personal search memo, arrest memos (11:45 & 11:50 hrs), spot site plan (Nazri Naksha).
Case Diary Zimni 4: return to PS at 13:10 hrs, Section 55 resealing before SHO, deposit in Malkhana Register 19.
Case Diary Zimni 5: dispatch of Section 57 report to Dy. SP, drafting and filing of Section 52A application before JMIC.
Malkhana Register Entry No. 19/2024, temporary withdrawal for Section 52A court proceedings on 10/04/2024, and dispatch to SFSL via RC.

conflicts.description: Discrepancy between spot seizure inventory and Magistrate court certificate. Document 688 records P-1 as 27.260 kg while Seizure Memo and Document 687 record 27.200 kg (+0.060 kg / +60 grams in court certification). Both values preserved; requires verification of court electronic scale calibration.

Discrepancy between spot seizure inventory and Magistrate court certificate. Document 688 records P-3 as 27.480 kg while Seizure Memo and Document 687 record 27.500 kg (-0.020 kg / -20 grams in court certification). Both values preserved without automated override.

Aggregate weight disparity: FIR, Seizure Memo, Section 55 Resealing (Doc 686), and Section 52A Inventory (Doc 687) record 108 kg 900 g (108.900 kg), whereas Magistrate Certificate (Doc 688) calculates aggregate parcel weight at 108.940 kg (+40 grams difference).
